notes: This minor release adds one review-required native Rust standard-library companion pack and changes nothing else. It is built by the same released, checksum-pinned bifrost-semantic-pack 0.15.1 as packs 0.13.0 (public commit 04fdd17d2606d13a7a5f13b012bfbe3ad9729d1e, executable SHA-256 7322cdbd653830aaba349c9a278eceb97573965739b2845412a3074080b6acc2), so it still needs Bifrost 0.15.1 or later, and the bundle keeps release index schema 4 and the same semantic-model read schemas (8, 14, 16, 19, 22). New native pack: bifrost.rust-std-deref-summaries 0.1.0 (MIT OR Apache-2.0) is an authored companion to bifrost.rust-stdlib for Rust nightly 2026-08-24 (=1.100.0-nightly). It holds only complete summaries for <String as Deref>::deref and <PathBuf as Deref>::deref: receiver to normal return through Conversion Identity, ordinary heap unchanged, no effects (#338). It is review-required and dormant: a consumer must explicitly enable it together with the matching bifrost.rust-stdlib, and a missing companion must fail closed. It does not certify callable-family completeness, so an uncertified String deref family stays incomplete, and the engine change that consumes these summaries is not in a Bifrost release yet. DerefMut is not covered. Source-only, not native additions: the Ruby bifrost.ruby.rexml, bifrost.ruby.net-imap and bifrost.ruby.rubygems-installer models and the C# bifrost.dotnet.aspnetcore-webassembly-server-csharp and bifrost.dotnet.aspnetcore-hosting-csharp models (#392). They need Bifrost 0.15.2 and are not in a release recipe. No pack was removed or renamed and no consumer requirement changed. Rules 0.14.0 keeps its exact dependency on packs 0.13.0; rules 0.15.0 moves it here. Generation, integrity, compatibility and per-run completeness remain separate from behavior qualification.
